title: Guided comparison
idea: Guided comparison: A short decision question opens into aligned tradeoffs and one user-adjustable relevant parameter.
audience: People who need to compare options within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Options differ on facts visitors can meaningfully assess.
avoidWhen: The business cannot support a truthful comparison.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its compare options priority and explicit commitment contract: Reflect supported values and disclose assumptions before recommending an option.
navigation: Guided comparison keeps the current compare options context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A short decision question opens into aligned tradeoffs and one user-adjustable relevant parameter.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to compare options; options differ on facts visitors can meaningfully assess.
composition.priority: Reflect supported values and disclose assumptions before recommending an option.

imagery.role: Support the actual compare options context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Stack each option with the same attribute order and preserve the current parameter.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the guided comparison structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no compare options content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Reflect supported values and disclose assumptions before recommending an option.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized compare options content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Reflect supported values and disclose assumptions before recommending an option.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active compare options context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
